name: FreeGSNKE tokamak coil design
description: design_coils(machine, target_boundary, plasma_profile) -> eight bounded active-coil currents in A for the published Anamak geometry. Evaluator runs pinned FreeGSNKE static equilibrium at two grid resolutions, checks nonlinear Grad-Shafranov residual, closed-plasma topology and current bounds, then scores boundary/axis mismatch. Targets/profile cases generated from the specified source model and saved with numerical reference checks. No physical reactor claim.

papers.title: Electromagnetic System Conceptual Design for a Negative Triangularity Tokamak
papers.task_relation: The local task chooses eight bounded currents for an idealized Anamak geometry using FreeGSNKE static equilibrium checks. The paper studies another device and equilibrium code, with additional engineering considerations; the task is a limited coil-setting problem, not a reactor design validation.
papers.primary_goal: Design and assess an electromagnetic coil system capable of supporting the target equilibrium of a proposed tokamak.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Choose tokamak poloidal-field coil settings that produce a desired plasma equilibrium and shape.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Electromagnetic design capable of producing a target plasma geometry is the substantive fusion-engineering problem addressed by the paper.
science_relevance.reason: The paper directly pursues magnetic-equilibrium design. A solver-software release is not used as the sole evidence.
